text:
OAK: Oh, RED!

How is my old POKeMON?

Well, it seems to like you a
lot.

You must be talented as a
POKeMON trainer!

What? You have something for
me?

RED delivered OAK's
PARCEL.

Ah! This is the custom POKe
BALL I ordered! Thank you!
BLUE: Gramps!

BLUE: What did you call
me for?

OAK: Oh right! I have a
request of you two.

On the desk there is my
invention, POKeDEX!

It automatically records
data on POKeMON you've seen
or caught!

It's a hi-tech encyclopedia!

OAK: RED and BLUE!
Take these with you!

RED got POKeDEX from
OAK!

To make a complete guide on
all the POKeMON in the
world...

That was my dream!

But, I'm too old! I can't do
it!

So, I want you two to
fulfill my dream for me!

Get moving, you two!

This is a great undertaking
in POKeMON history!

BLUE: Alright Gramps!
Leave it all to me!

RED, I hate to say it,
but I don't need you!

I know! I'll borrow a TOWN
MAP from my sis!

I'll tell her not to lend
you one, RED! Hahaha!

OAK: RED, raise your
young POKeMON by making it
fight!
